team.name: HiZJU-China

role.zh: UniCO-Fuel · CO₂ 制 EPI 燃料

team.description: UniCO-Fuel 提出将火星大气 CO₂ 经光催化转化为甲醇，再由工程毕赤酵母通过 MVA 通路与 EIZS 合成 epi-Isozizaene（EPI），经两相萃取与纯化获得候选高能液体燃料。方案结合辅因子调节、蓝光 CRISPRi 动态代谢调控、光衰减模型及多层生物安全防护。
team.description_en: UniCO-Fuel proposes photocatalytic conversion of Martian atmospheric CO₂ to methanol, followed by engineered Pichia pastoris using the MVA pathway and EIZS to produce epi-Isozizaene (EPI). Two-phase extraction and purification yield a candidate high-energy liquid fuel. The design includes cofactor regulation, blue-light CRISPRi metabolic control, a light attenuation model and layered biosafety measures.

narrative.zh: UniCO-Fuel 提出将火星大气 CO₂ 经光催化转化为甲醇，再由工程毕赤酵母通过 MVA 通路与 EIZS 合成 epi-Isozizaene（EPI），经两相萃取与纯化获得候选高能液体燃料。方案结合辅因子调节、蓝光 CRISPRi 动态代谢调控、光衰减模型及多层生物安全防护。

The design includes cofactor regulation, blue-light CRISPRi metabolic control, a light attenuation model and layered biosafety measures.

nodes.description: 工程毕赤酵母利用甲醇，经中心代谢、MVA 通路与异源 EIZS 合成 EPI；设计通过关键酶、NADPH 和 ATP 调节改善前体及能量供给。蓝光 CRISPRi 提供三种候选策略，抑制竞争代谢或控制 EPI 末步，以协调生长和生产；光衰减模型指导高密度培养中的光照与诱导。防护设计包含细胞内黑色素、营养缺陷、低温响应自杀开关及反应器防尘、紫外过滤、透光和保温。EPI 进入两相发酵的上层有机相，经分离纯化获得产品，萃取相回用。
nodes.description_en: Engineered Pichia pastoris converts methanol through central metabolism, the MVA pathway and heterologous EIZS to EPI. Key-enzyme, NADPH and ATP regulation are designed to improve precursor and energy supply. Three candidate blue-light CRISPRi strategies suppress competing metabolism or control the final EPI step to coordinate growth and production; a light attenuation model guides lighting and induction in dense cultures. Protection includes intracellular melanin, auxotrophy, low-temperature-responsive suicide switches, and reactor dust barriers, UV filtering, light transmission and insulation. EPI partitions into the upper organic phase during two-phase fermentation, followed by separation and purification; the extraction phase is recycled.

nodes.description: 收集、压缩并富集火星大气 CO₂，以 g-C₃N₄ 基光催化体系制甲醇。拟通过元素掺杂与异质结构改善可见光利用、载流子分离和选择性。
nodes.description_en: Martian atmospheric CO₂ is collected, compressed and enriched for methanol production using a proposed g-C₃N₄ photocatalyst. Doping and heterostructures aim to improve visible-light utilization, carrier separation and selectivity.
